items.t: Bitcoin Stocks Remain Under Pressure, but RIOT Platforms Stands Out as a Selective Outlier
items.sum: Bitcoin-related equities remain weak overall, but RIOT stands out with a sharp monthly gain while MSTR, COIN and MARA lag, signaling a selective bid.

items.t: Riot Platforms Just Gained 18% in a Month on a $28 Billion AI Lease. Take Profits, or Buy More?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysRiot Platforms rose 18% in a month on a $28 billion lease to Anthropic. Riot’s tenant buys the computers, so unlike IREN, Riot builds at about half the usual cost and doesn’t currently expect to sell stock.
